immutability.correctionRule: A later correction must be a separately identified append-only review that pins this exact review and its reviewed successor.

closedFindings: IAQ-062 now retains the exact PRIMARY_DWP_CONTROL semantic role while the surrounding ownership contract preserves its external-page data-projection relationship.

The exact twenty route descriptors form a gap-free partition of four read, eight author-action and eight executor-action routes and match both the operation bindings and product-authorization route list.

The settings-operations authority predicate receives all twenty exact reverse route appendages and the reference-configuration predicate receives only the sixteen object-bound routes; no new broad predicate is introduced.

The two new capability descriptors and Auth V269 tuples use CONFIG.HRIS_INTEGRATION and ACTION.HRIS_INTEGRATION_CONTROL_PLANE, avoiding both historical hcm.integration.execute and the V266 workforce-ingestion-only resource, duty and preset.

The exact v59 counts and checksum produce the sealed v60 totals with two capabilities and twenty routes, and V269 remains a catalog-only default-OFF seed with zero assignment, activation, enrollment or broad grant.

The closed transport contract directly pins the executable G2 schema artifact and the semantic field seal, so headers, paths, request, response, Problem, CAS and idempotency behavior cannot be locally widened.
Every opaque reference is server-resolved only after tenant, connector, subject, purpose, type, namespace, digest and authorization-revision binding, with egress and secret non-disclosure guards.
SYS-EVT-005 is a closed executable Draft 2020-12 object schema with the exact owner-state enum, terminal reconciliation-digest condition, server count guards and atomic outbox boundary.
PDX-008 distinguishes dry-run TENANT/null scope, tenant execution, verified LEGAL_ENTITY execution and exact reconciliation inheritance while forbidding caller override and reverse intent inference.

Platform V334 remains an unreserved unauthored candidate containing exactly six new connector tables, immutable definition versions, forced tenant controls and reuse-only receipt, event, audit and operations stores.

The frontend remains unmounted and default OFF: SYS-008 owns only /hr/settings/integrations while the existing DWP productivity page receives a separately authorized HCM data child without reownership.

The successor grants only a subsequent bounded central implementation after this review and grants no owner packet, V334 lease, worktree, token, source, route mount, tenant enrollment, provider binding, customer data or completion credit.
